dek: Over 90 per cent of more than 6,000 public submissions have voiced support for Hong Kong’s sexual offences reform, the city’s security chief has said, as he pledged to table a bill to the legislature within the year. Secretary for Security Chris Tang also said on Friday that the government had noted public views regard
